messages:
maya: heads up — eu-west GPU pools at 96% for the last 6m, high-priority queue depth spiked. admission-control started shedding lower tiers, seeing retries in app logs.
infra-bot: alert: region/eu-west/gpu-util=96% queue-depth=423 high-priority=112 — runbook suggests graceful-degrade or regional-handshake.
jon: thanks. are we automatically spilling to eu-central per current routing?
maya: not enough cold capacity there right now, and cross-region p99 latency to eu-central ~170ms which breaks chat SLO for interactive sessions. we need a short-term plan: graceful degrade + model fallback in-region, and controlled cross-region only for latency-tolerant flows.
sasha: +1. proposal: implement immediate in-region fallback to a quantized smaller model for HP when admission-control triggers, deny standard tier, and only allow cross-region spill if request has latency_tolerant flag. pseudo-config: 
```yaml
routing:
  on_saturation:
    - match: tier==high
      action:
        fallback: model-x-small-q4
        allow_cross_region: false
    - match: tier==standard
      action: deny
```
ryan: that seems reasonable. also propose temporary per-customer burst credits to avoid hard 429s for long-running sessions (token-bucket tweak).
maya: we can bump burst for top customers 20->40 tokens for 10m windows. quick cost ballpark if sustained: ~$3k/day.
jon: if we fallback to quantized small model we should tag those requests so Optimize/evals can monitor quality deltas and alert if regressions spike. want rollback hooks.
sasha: canary idea: route 5% of HP to eu-central (full model) so we keep a quality sample and a fallback path.
infra-bot: deploybot: routing-policy v3.4 proposed by sasha — awaiting review.
maya: I'll open infra ticket and roll this policy as a short-lived feature flag. tagging @ryan @jon for quick approvals.
ryan: approved. I'll also tell autoscaler to try to spin 2 nodes in eu-central, ETA ~8m (cold start).
jon: low-friction mitigation — reduce seq_len cap from 2048->1024 for standard tier to cut KV cache pressure. low lift, high impact.
maya: agreed, do it. quick internal API call: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/routes -d '{"policy":"short-term-degrade","seq_len_cap":1024}'
```
sasha: I'll add dashboards for model_fallback_rate and per-region spill_rate, and a short alert if fallback exceeds 15% for >5m.
maya: ack — implementing now. will post incident summary in #incidents after stabilization. :thumbsup:
